eas_text: A civil authority has issued A BLUE ALERT for the following counties or areas: El Paso; Pueblo; Teller; Fremont, CO; at 7:43 AM on AUG 25, 2026 Effective until 10:43 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Colorado Bureau of Investigation with a BLUE Alert. We have received this important announcement regarding a seriously injured peace officer in Teller County, Colorado. The Colorado State Patrol is searching for a white, male, with facial hair and brown or blonde shoulder length hair last seen in the vicinity of highway 24 and piney point lane at 7:15 this morning. The suspect may be traveling in a blue Subaru Imprezza that has no or obscured license plates. This individual may be armed and dangerous, do not approach. If you have any information, please call 9  1  1.
